research_question: For 3-day direction, can causal local training on historically similar market states recover more stable predictive skill than using all matured history or the equally sized most-recent history window?
literature_basis: Similarity-based forecasting and nearest-neighbour/local regression: historical observations similar to the current state may be more informative than merely recent observations.
Flexible rolling-window forecasting: weighting observations by similarity to the current regime can outperform fixed or purely recent windows under structural breaks and nonlinear misspecification.
Conditional/state-dependent predictive ability: useful predictors may have pockets of predictability rather than constant global skill.

V1.67 empirical trigger: SESSION_RM and MACRO_CROSS each showed positive skill in 2 of 3 pre-2025 environments but failed global invariance, motivating local-regime rather than global-invariant learning.

source_artifact.immutability: Use the frozen V1.64 panel only. No external data fetch or post-score feature creation.

target.definition: y_t = 1[close_{t+3} > close_t] using the next three rows of the frozen NY17 panel
target.maturity_rule: Training rows at origin t require target_date < origin_date_t.

state_distance.imputation: At each origin, fill state missing values using medians from matured historical rows only.
state_distance.scaling: At each origin, z-score state variables using means and standard deviations from matured historical rows only; zero-variance columns receive unit scale.
state_distance.metric: Euclidean distance on the frozen standardized state vector.
state_distance.neighbour_weighting: Equal weight among the K nearest matured historical states; no distance-kernel tuning in V1.68.

forecast_models.GLOBAL: L2 logistic regression on all matured history.
forecast_models.RECENT_K: Same L2 logistic regression on the K most recent matured rows.
forecast_models.SIMILAR_K: Same L2 logistic regression on the K nearest matured rows in frozen state space.

model_lock.one_class_fallback: GLOBAL if local subset has one realized class; 0.5 only if GLOBAL also has one class.
model_lock.hyperparameter_search: Only K may be selected from the frozen pre-2025 grid. All other model parameters are fixed.

k_selection.selection_rule: Choose one K shared by both predictor blocks. Minimize mean Brier loss of SIMILAR_K over all causal origins in S1/S2/S3 and both blocks. Ties: lower log loss, then larger K. 2024Q4/2025/2026 cannot influence K.
k_selection.causal_origin_rule: Every prediction at every selection origin may use only target-matured history before that origin.

benchmark.CAUSAL_FREQUENCY: Expanding prior matured UP frequency; fallback 0.5 if fewer than 20 matured labels.
benchmark.GLOBAL: Same predictor block and logistic family using all matured history.
benchmark.RECENT_K: Same predictor block and logistic family using the K most recent matured rows.

visible_persistence_gate_per_block.use: Retrospective diagnostic persistence only; not fresh OOS.

decision_lock.if_bridge_and_visible_persistence_pass: Candidate may proceed only to a separately frozen prospective-shadow study.
decision_lock.if_bridge_pass_visible_fail: Local similarity is not persistent enough; return to new-information or target/horizon redesign.
decision_lock.if_bridge_fail: Reject regime-similarity escalation for this information set; do not tune state variables or K after seeing bridge/visible results.
decision_lock.if_similarity_beats_recent_but_not_frequ: Record evidence that state similarity helps adaptation but not enough for forecast skill; do not promote.
